entities.name: Authentication failure parameter
entities.description: Information element included in 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure when 5GMM cause is #21 'synch failure'. Contains the AUTS parameter which is the response to the authentication challenge from the USIM.

entities.name: 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Primary authentication and key agreement procedure using 5G AKA method.

entities.name: 5GMM cause #21 synch failure
entities.description: Condition where the 5GMM cause value is set to #21 indicating synchronization failure.

entities.name: AUTS parameter
entities.description: Response to the authentication challenge from the USIM, part of the authentication failure parameter.

relations.description: The authentication failure parameter IE is included in the 5G AKA authentication procedure
The authentication failure parameter is included if and only if the 5GMM cause is #21 'synch failure'
The authentication failure parameter includes the AUTS parameter as the response to the authentication challenge
